name: ag-ui
author: Markus Ecker <markus.ecker@gmail.com>

scripts.build:clean: pnpm run clean && pnpm install && pnpm run build
scripts.dev: pnpm run build --projects=sdks/** && nx watch --projects=sdks/** -- pnpm run build --projects=sdks/**
scripts.dev:integrations: pnpm run build --projects=integrations/** && nx watch --projects=integrations/** -- pnpm run build --projects=integrations/**
scripts.dev:middlewares: pnpm run build --projects=middlewares/** && nx watch --projects=middlewares/** -- pnpm run build --projects=middlewares/**
scripts.test:watch: nx run-many -t test && nx watch --all -- nx run-many -t test
scripts.publish: pnpm run clean && pnpm install && pnpm run build && pnpm publish -r --filter='./sdks/typescript/packages/*'
scripts.publish:integrations: pnpm run clean && pnpm install && pnpm run build && pnpm publish -r --filter='./integrations/*'
scripts.publish:alpha: pnpm run clean && pnpm install && pnpm run build && pnpm publish -r --no-git-checks --filter='./sdks/typescript/packages/*' --tag alpha

//ag-ui-workspace-overrides: TEMPORARY, MUST BE REVERTED BEFORE RELEASE. Tracked in PNI-275 (same pin
The four "@ag-ui/*": "workspace:*" overrides at the top of pnpm.overrides
below exist only because of that pin: the pkg.pr.new CopilotKit preview
builds declare dependencies on the PUBLISHED @ag-ui/core (and friends), which
would install a second, older copy alongside the workspace packages this
branch is developing. Two copies means two Event/Message type identities and
subagent events that typecheck in one copy and not the other. Forcing every
resolution to the workspace copy keeps a single instance.
Remove these four entries together with the CopilotKit preview pin, once a
released @copilotkit/react-core depends on a published @ag-ui/core that
carries subagent support. The remaining overrides are unrelated and stay.
